name: Le Jardinier Houston
dinnerNote: Seasonal Expression menu, 5 courses (four-course lunch menu $90, two-course lunch $45)
lunchNote: Art Lovers Lunch, 2 courses, Wed–Fri (four-course seasonal lunch menu $90)

menus.name: Seasonal Expression menu
menus.note: The chef's seasonal menu at dinner, for the whole table. Includes caviar and shaved black truffle.

menus.name: Art Lovers Lunch
menus.note: Starter and main, Wednesday to Friday 11:30am to 2pm; dessert $10 more.

bookingOpens: Online on SevenRooms (also listed on OpenTable).
groups: The main dining room can be booked for private dinners of up to 90, the bar and lounge for up to 30, and the Kinder Private Room next door seats 20 at one long table, all with set menus. Enquire through the website.
